items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: And here are the arrangers, and there's Lionel Newman...

ctx.x: Challenge...!? You're up at six o'clock in the morning, you've got to drive all the way across town, clear across Coldwater Canyon, through Robinson's, out to Fox. And you park your car and you walk in, and you look at the piano. There's a great big stack of music. And here are the arrangers, and there's Lionel Newman... And thank God for Irving Thielman(?), he was there, because he could cover me when I couldn't cut it. Irving Thielman(?) gave me the greatest advice I ever had in my life about music. He said,…

There were challenges, plenty of them. Boy. I used to go in there and walk in the studio, look at the music, said, 'Oh Jesus, I can't play this shit.' But somehow, I'd make it. How, I don't know. I'd go and study the saxophone
